mkdir -p {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/haploid

non_rep_Mask_ape_s1_diploid.spec:
set -e
        mkdir -p {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/mask
        WORK=$(mktemp -d)
        trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
        for contig in c1 c2; do
            awk 'FNR>1 {print $1 "\t" $2 "\t" $3}' {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/ape/s1/${contig}_M0.bed {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/ape/s1/${contig}_M1.bed {ROOT}/output/repetitive_dna/ape/s1/${contig}_M2.bed > $WORK/mask.bed
            cut -f1-3 {ROOT}/output/precomute/ape/s1/unresolved_haplotypes/${contig}.bed >> $WORK/mask.bed
            sort -k1,1 -k2,2n $WORK/mask.bed | bedtools merge -i - > {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/mask/${contig}.bed.tmp
            mv {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/mask/${contig}.bed.tmp {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/mask/${contig}.bed
        done

mkdir -p {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/merged {ROOT}/plots/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1
        awk 'FNR==1 && NR==1 || FNR>1' {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/opportunities/c1.tsv {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/opportunities/c2.tsv \

non_rep_MergeWindows_ape_s1_diploid.spec:
set -e
        mkdir -p {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/calls {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/opportunities {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/fastq
        awk 'FNR==1 && NR==1 || FNR>1' {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/calls/chunks/c1_0_10000000.tsv {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/calls/chunks/c1_10000000_12000000.tsv > {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/calls/c1.tsv
        awk -F'\t' -v OFS='\t' 'FNR==1 {if (NR==1) print; next} {n[$1 OFS $2 OFS $3 OFS $4 OFS $5] += $6} END {for (key in n) print key, n[key]}' {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/opportunities/chunks/c1_0_10000000.tsv {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/opportunities/chunks/c1_10000000_12000000.tsv > {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/opportunities/c1.tsv
        cat {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/fastq/chunks/c1_0_10000000.fastq {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/fastq/chunks/c1_10000000_12000000.fastq | awk 'NR % 4 == 1 {keep = !seen[$1]++} keep' > {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/fastq/c1.fastq
        awk 'FNR==1 && NR==1 || FNR>1' {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/calls/chunks/c2_0_1500000.tsv > {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/calls/c2.tsv
        awk -F'\t' -v OFS='\t' 'FNR==1 {if (NR==1) print; next} {n[$1 OFS $2 OFS $3 OFS $4 OFS $5] += $6} END {for (key in n) print key, n[key]}' {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/opportunities/chunks/c2_0_1500000.tsv > {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/opportunities/c2.tsv
        cat {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/fastq/chunks/c2_0_1500000.fastq | awk 'NR % 4 == 1 {keep = !seen[$1]++} keep' > {ROOT}/output/nonrepetitive_indels/ape/s1/fastq/c2.fastq
